title: GENUINE Rock Band USB Microphone PS2 PS3 PS4 Xbox 360 Xbox One Logitech
categoryName: Video Games & Consoles:Video Game Accessories:Controllers & Attachments
descriptionText:
This GENUINE Rock Band USB Microphone is perfect for any gamer who wants to enhance their gaming experience. It is compatible with various platforms such as Microsoft Xbox One, Microsoft Xbox, Microsoft Xbox 360, Sony PlayStation 4, Sony PlayStation 3, and Nintendo Wii. The microphone is made of high-quality plastic material and comes in a sleek black color.

With this microphone, you can enjoy playing your favorite games with friends and family. It is wired and has a USB connectivity option, making it easy to use. The microphone is compatible with a maximum of one player and is perfect for both console and PC gaming. It is also compatible with various game controllers and accessories.
